title: GTFToSleep
description: Set your real-world bedtime. You'll be kicked off the server when that time comes.
body:
# GTF To Bed
Do you find it hard to stop playing Minecraft? Do you end up staying up late at night playing when you need to be sleeping?
Me too! That's why I made this mod.

## What it does
You set a (real life) bedtime. Minecraft kicks you off when your bedtime arrives, and lets you back in the next day (7am by default, but you can change that). If you try to login before morning, you'll just get kicked with an error message.
You'll also get warnings as bedtime approaches - 1 hour, 30 minutes, 5 minutes, 1 minute, 30 seconds, 10 seconds. And don't think you can push bedtime back - once you've got your hour's warning you can't change your bedtime until tomorrow!

## Commands
This mod provides a single root `/bedtime` command, with the following subcommands:

* `/bedtime`: Lists you current bedtime, wake time and timezone
* `/bedtime tz <timezone>: Sets your timezone; a [TZ identifier](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones) or UTC offset
* `/bedtime set <time>`: Sets your bedtime
* `/bedtime clear`: Clears your bedtime
* `/bedtime wakeup <time>`: Sets your wake time
